_corrections._why_twice: This component was rebuilt twice from wrong readings. Recorded in full because the failure mode — reading a hidden node and believing it — is not specific to checkbox.
_corrections.build-1: Drew the box in CSS and invented a radius, border width and focus ring. Wrong values, right idea.
_corrections.build-2: Concluded 'Figma draws the whole control as an icon' and removed the box entirely. That was read off `Outline/Old/Check` — a HIDDEN, ORPHANED legacy instance sitting inside every unchecked variant. The result rendered a tick when the box was empty and had no box at all.
_corrections.build-3: Read all 14 variants and their frame properties. The frame draws the box (fill, stroke, radius 4); the icon is only the glyph, and only on two states.

Figma is the value authority and the team chose to keep it; if the intent later changes, the fix is one value in this file.
_figma_gaps.no-checked-hover: Figma draws no Hover, Focus or Error variant for a checked box. This component keeps the checked fill and layers the emphasis border, which is an extrapolation, not a reading.
